kids.content: Table 1. Number of species and zoogeographical endemicities in the nine zoological regions (endemicities are the ratios of endemics to total species)
occurs in more than one zoological region, we count it as present in each region in which it lives.

We transformed the variables S and AE to common logarithms. Then we performed univariate and bivariate linear regressions and calculated the usual statistics: intercepts, coefficients, probabilities, and R 2 -values. We excluded Hawaii from the regression analyses for Amphibia and Reptilia because these classes are not found in that zoological region.
